messages.content: 如果我從紐約出發，途經費城、華盛頓特區和亞特蘭大，最後抵達邁阿密，預計的旅行時間會是多少？另外，如果我不停留在亞特蘭大，直接從華盛頓特區前往邁阿密，會是多少時間？最後，如果我從改成從費城出發，停留華盛頓特區，然後抵達邁阿密，會是多少時間？

function.name: route_estimate_time
function.description: Estimate the travel time for a specific route with optional stops. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The starting point for the journey.

stops.description: Additional cities or points of interest to stop at during the journey ordered.

message.reasoning:
We need to estimate travel times using the tool `route_estimate_time`. We have three scenarios:

1) Start NYC -> Philadelphia (费城), Washington DC, Atlanta, Miami.

2) Start NYC -> Philadelphia? Wait second scenario says "不止留在亚特兰大" meaning skip Atlanta; directly from Washington DC to Miami after stopping at Philadelphia and Washington DC presumably. So start NYC -> Philadelphia -> Washington DC -> Miami.

But question states: "另外，如果我不停留在亞特蘭大，直接从华盛顿特区前往迈阿密，会是多少时间?" That implies we still include Philadelphia as first stop? It might mean same initial path but skipping Atlanta. So yes: NYC->Philadelphia->Washington DC->Miami.

Third scenario: Starting from Philadelphia instead of New York, then stop at Washington DC, then reach Miami. So start location changed to Philadelphia, end remains Miami, stops includes Washington DC only.

Thus calls:

First call: start_location="New York City", end_location="Miami", stops=["Philadelphia","Washington D.C.","Atlanta"].

Second call: start_location="New York City", end_location="Miami", stops=["Philadelphia","Washington D.C."]. No Atlanta.

Third call: start_location="Philadelphia", end_location="Miami", stops=["Washington D.C."]

Return results accordingly. Use tool invocation format exactly.
